## humanize-text-skill 0.1.1

- Switched primary repository and branding to Lynote.ai (https://lynote.ai).
- Added project, log, and state files to support broader deployment and provenance tracking.
- Updated documentation to clarify the relationship between the open skill and the Lynote product.
- Improved attribution and maintainership details throughout. 
- Removed legacy skill-card.md file.

Initial release of humanize-text-skill.

- Audits and rewrites Chinese or English content to remove AI tone and match a target human voice.
- Supports detect-only, rewrite, and edit-in-place modes, protecting anchored facts ("protected spans").
- Offers scene packs and voice profiles, including custom calibration from user samples.
- Flags and rewrites AI-linked vocabulary, structures, tone artifacts, and stylometric patterns.
- Designed for any agent that supports the agentskills.io SKILL.md format. No external tools required.
